15. (Currently Amended) A method of selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising the steps of: accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, __wherein the information is added prior to transmission of the locator to the client computer__; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, __wherein the selection is performed by a media request broker receiving the information from the client computer in response to the client computer's access of the locator__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 15, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the method further comprising the steps of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, __wherein the media request broker receives the http request and determines the first server computer based on the unique signature and the information added to the locator__.

17. (Original)

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, the media request broker selecting the first server computer based on the information __and the unique signature contained in the http request, wherein the selection criteria include load balancing information and server availability data__.

24. (Currently Amended) A system for selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the system comprising: a client computer; a first server computer; a second server computer; and a media request broker, __wherein the media request broker is configured to receive a locator from the client computer, the locator including information indicative of at least one server computer of a first set of one or more server computers, the information being added to the locator prior to transmission to the client computer, and wherein the media request broker selects the first server computer based on the information and a unique signature associated with the resource__.

25. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 24, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the system further comprising circuitry for selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, __wherein the media request broker receives the http request and processes the unique signature to determine the first server computer__.

27. (Currently Amended) A computer program product for selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the computer program product comprising: a computer-readable medium; and program instructions stored on the computer-readable medium, the program instructions comprising: instructions for accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; instructions for adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, __wherein the information is added prior to transmission of the locator to the client computer__; instructions for identifying a unique signature as part of the resource's identifier; and instructions for selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, __wherein the selection is performed by a media request broker receiving the information from the client computer__.

28.
